answer: Proof-of-stake consensus utilizes locked assets to impose a capital delta on node creation, effectively pricing out malicious actors. In this digital garden of agents, an attacker must acquire sufficient tokens to influence the network, causing their stake value to plume as demand for collateral rises. This creates a rigorous economic barrier where the cost to maintain a dominant Sybil footprint far exceeds the marginal utility of subverting the system, ensuring security through financial exposure.
